Anita (Capacity Ops): @channel heads-up: we're opening a short reservation window for Reserved Edge GPU capacity in ap-southeast-3 (Jakarta) next week. This is targeted at customers running latency-sensitive edge inference. Window: Tue 2026-04-14 07:00-11:00 UTC. During the 4h window we'll allow new reservations and run the fair-share rotation to rebalance long-running reservations.
Anita (Capacity Ops): Why: we need to move a subset of preemptible workloads to alternate pools to free contiguous slots for enterprise reserved allocations. This avoids long manual migrations later and keeps latency SLOs for edge customers.
Anita (Capacity Ops): What to expect:
- Customers with active preemptible reservations may see short 1-2 minute warmup when their jobs are migrated.
- New reserved bookings will be accepted during the window; billing starts on confirmation.
- We'll run an automated rotation policy (fairshare-v2) that prioritizes active reserved contracts, then Dedicated reserved, then preemptible.
- If you have pinned model versions, they will be floated to compatible hardware automatically; see runbook link below.
Anita (Capacity Ops): Action items for internal teams:
- Eng-oncall: monitor ap-southeast-3 pool during window (watch: rtx8200-edge-01 metrics).
- Product: notify active reserved customers in that region; template in #customer-success/dedicated-templates.
- Billing: ensure pro-rata for reservations started during window is handled (ref: billing runbook v3).
ops-bot: Scheduled job created: rotate-fairshare-apse3 at 2026-04-14T07:10:00Z (id: rotate-apse3-231234).
Mike R: Thanks Anita — can you confirm whether this affects Dedicated hot-standby pools too?
Anita (Capacity Ops): Good question. Hot-standby Dedicated pools (named ds-hot-*) are excluded from the automatic rotation; they remain pinned. Only normal Dedicated and preemptible pools are part of fairshare-v2.
Sarah L: Quick customer question — if a reserved booking is accepted during the window but migration completes after the window, will they get any latency impact credit?
Anita (Capacity Ops): We won't issue automatic credits for <5m ephemeral warmups from migrations. If the customer reports sustained latency regressions (>15m) we will escalate and consider credit on case-by-case basis.
Nina (Prod Eng): Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/capacity/runbooks/apse3-fairshare-v2.md — includes the `rotate-fairshare` dry-run command and rollback steps. Example snippet: ```sh
./rotate-fairshare --region ap-southeast-3 --dry-run
```
Mike R: Noted. Any telemetry dashboards to watch specifically?
Anita (Capacity Ops): Watch these Dashboards: `Edge / ap-southeast-3 / Allocation`, `Edge / ap-southeast-3 / Latency 99p`, and the `rotate-fairshare` job logs in /ops/jobs.
ops-bot: @here rotate-fairshare-apse3 job queued for 2026-04-14T07:10:00Z.
Sarah L: Can we add a small banner to Console (region: Jakarta) notifying users of the window? Customers sometimes miss emails.
Anita (Capacity Ops): Yes — Product can add a temporary banner for 24h centered on the window. I've pinged Product in #product.
Mike R: ack :thumbsup:
Anita (Capacity Ops): Post-mortem note: we'll run a 72h post-check to ensure no allocation thrashing. If anyone sees unexpected migrations after the window, ping me directly.
Anita (Capacity Ops): TL;DR: 4h booking/migration window in ap-southeast-3 on 2026-04-14 07:00-11:00 UTC, fairshare-v2 rotation will run, hot-standby pools excluded, watch dashboards and ops job.
